system.name: NativeEmbodied
system.one_liner: A benchmark for VLM-driven embodied agents in a native low-level action space, with four low-level skill tasks and three high-level tasks evaluated jointly.

content.variant_note: two dashed groups of task cards (four low-level skills, three high-level tasks), each card with a scene render, an instruction and an action list, plus a radar chart of seven VLMs between the groups
content.argues: The benchmark covers four foundational low-level skills and three complex high-level tasks in a native action space, and the models' scores differ strongly across them.
content.subject: seven task cards with indoor scene renders and action lists, plus a radar chart of seven VLMs

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a benchmark as task cards that each hold one render with overlays, an instruction and the expected action list, and put a radar chart between the card groups; colour the tab of each group differently so two granularities read apart.
lessons.suits: Benchmark papers for embodied or agent tasks with a few task families, real example instructions and per-model scores to show.

sections: 3 NativeEmbodied Benchmark (section label in the index; no paragraph mentions the figure)
evidence: Our NativeEmbodied benchmark includes four fundamental low-level tasks (i.e., Perception, Alignment, Navigation and Planning)
three integrated high-level tasks (i.e., Exploration, Interaction, and Search)
adopts a unified, native low-level action space

summary: NativeEmbodied is a benchmark for vision-language-model embodied agents that act through a native low-level action space. Figure 1 presents it as two dashed groups of example cards. At left, four low-level skill cards (Perception, Alignment, Navigation, Planning) and at right three high-level task cards (Exploration, Search, Interaction) each show an indoor scene render with red target boxes and blue paths, a bold italic instruction and a monospace action list. Between the groups, a seven-vertex radar chart compares seven VLMs (Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-4.0-Opus, GPT-o3 and others) as coloured polygons named in the plot. The figure states the tasks and the results, not a method.
summary_zh: NativeEmbodied 是面向视觉语言模型具身智能体的基准，使用原生低层动作空间。图用两组虚线卡片展示四个低层技能和三个高层任务，每张卡片配室内场景渲染、指令和动作列表，中间的雷达图比较七个模型的表现。
notes: The prior labels listed contribution-mosaic first; the figure reads mainly as a benchmark scope overview (tasks plus a result chart), so scope-overview is primary here. No paragraph mentions the figure, and the radar axes are unlabelled: that each vertex stands for one of the seven tasks is inferred from the seven vertices. The seven cards are described as elements and only the two titled dashed groups as panels.
